name: Ian Eisele
title: Laboratory Informatics Scientist
bio: I'm a lab informatics scientist, a chemist by training with two decades spanning chromatography and software. I work across CDS, SDMS, LIMS, and data analytics — automating scientific workflows and building FAIR data foundations that make lab data ready for AI/ML. As a product owner, I turn what scientists need into what software teams build. As a technical marketing specialist, I turn what we build into clear value for the scientists who use it.
I like making instruments and software easier to use, and helping scientists get more out of both.
